title: Darkstar (Top Gun: Maverick)
intro: The Darkstar is the fictional hypersonic test aircraft that Maverick flies past ten times the speed of sound at the start of Top Gun: Maverick (2022). It is powered by a scramjet, a jet engine for extreme speeds. The single-seat cockpit belongs to a full-size mock-up built for the film with help from Lockheed Martin Skunk Works engineers; the pilot wears a full pressure suit.

areas.name: Canopy
areas.text: The small windows of the hypersonic airframe.

panels.name: Canopy
panels.text: The small windows of the Darkstar's cockpit.
panels.context: A plane this fast has only small windows.

controls.name: Windows
controls.text: Small windows in the nose give the pilot a limited view.
controls.context: At such speeds the pilot depends on the screens more than the view outside.

areas.name: Large displays
areas.text: The glass cockpit in front of the pilot.

panels.name: Large displays
panels.text: Big screens in front of the pilot show all the flight information.
panels.context: This kind of cockpit is called a glass cockpit.

controls.name: Primary flight display
controls.text: The main screen shows the flight data: speed, height and whether the nose is up or down.
controls.context: It is the screen the pilot watches most.

controls.name: Mach readout
controls.text: This number shows the speed as a Mach number, how many times faster than sound the aircraft flies.
controls.context: In the opening flight of the film it climbs past Mach 10.

areas.name: Ejection seat
areas.text: The seat of the pressure-suited pilot.

panels.name: Ejection seat
panels.text: The seat that can shoot the pilot out of the aircraft in an emergency.
panels.context: The pilot wears a full pressure suit because the aircraft flies very high.

controls.name: Ejection handle
controls.text: Pulling this handle fires the ejection seat, which shoots the pilot out of the aircraft.
controls.context: In the film Maverick ejects as the aircraft breaks apart.

controls.name: Pressure suit
controls.text: A full pressure suit and helmet that keep the pilot alive at extreme height.
controls.context: Up there the air is too thin to breathe; the suit gives the body the pressure it needs.

areas.name: Stick and throttle
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Control stick
panels.text: The control stick in front of the Darkstar pilot.
panels.context: It steers the aircraft at every speed.

controls.name: Control stick
controls.text: Pushing the stick forward or pulling it back tips the nose down or up; moving it left or right rolls the aircraft.
controls.context: At hypersonic speed small movements have a big effect.

panels.name: Throttle
panels.text: The throttle at the Darkstar pilot's left hand.
panels.context: It sets the thrust, from turbine to scramjet.

controls.name: Throttle
controls.text: Pushing the throttle forward gives more thrust. At high speed the engine changes from turbine mode to scramjet mode.
controls.context: The scramjet only works at very high speed, so the aircraft first accelerates with the turbine.
